user.title: Connect to Mitipi Kevin
user.description: Choose how to sign in to your KEVIN® account. The integration talks only to the Kevin API.

menu_options.mitipi: Sign in with Mitipi (Google, Apple or email)

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Mitipi Kevin again
reauth_confirm.description: Home Assistant is no longer signed in to your KEVIN® account. Sign in again to keep your devices and automations working.

menu_options.mitipi: Sign in with Mitipi (Google, Apple or email)

password.title: Sign in with email and password
password.description: Use the email and password of your KEVIN® account. They are stored in Home Assistant so the integration can sign in again on its own.

auth.title: Sign in with Mitipi
auth.description: A new browser tab opens the Mitipi sign-in page. Sign in there with Google, Apple or your email; the tab returns here on its own.

progress.auth: Finish signing in on the Mitipi page that opened in a new tab.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kevin API. Try again later.

abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different KEVIN® account than the one this entry belongs to. Sign in with the original account, or add the other account as a new entry.
abort.no_sign_in_method: Signing in from Home Assistant is turned off for KEVIN® accounts right now. Try again later or contact Mitipi support.
abort.my_home_assistant_required: Sign in with Mitipi needs the My Home Assistant integration (`my:` in configuration.yaml, part of `default_config`). Enable it and restart, or sign in with email and password.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kevin API. Try again later.
abort.oauth_error: The Mitipi sign-in returned an unexpected answer. Try again.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not finish signing in with Mitipi. Try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: Signing in with Mitipi timed out. Try again.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: The Mitipi sign-in was not accepted. Try again, or contact Mitipi support if it keeps happening.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out preparing the Mitipi sign-in page.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL for the sign-in to return to. See {docs_url}.
abort.missing_configuration: Sign in with Mitipi is not available in this release.

set_preferences.name: Set preferences
set_preferences.description: Change where KEVIN lives, who lives there, and how busy and lively it is. Mirrors the Mitipi app: a fresh preset recommendation is generated and the full selection is saved.

environment.name: Environment
environment.description: HOME, BUSINESS or INDUSTRIAL. Switching resets lifestyle toggles that do not exist in the new environment.

characteristics.name: Lifestyle
characteristics.description: Toggles for the environment, for example {"kids": true, "dogs": false}.

occupancy_level.name: Occupancy
occupancy_level.description: How many people are usually around, 0 to 10.

energy_level.name: Energy
energy_level.description: How lively the place is, 0 to 10.

update_available.title: Mitipi Kevin {latest} is available
update_available.description: You have Mitipi Kevin {installed}. Version {latest} is out, but HACS could not be asked to show it. Open HACS, choose Mitipi Kevin → Update information, then install the update and restart Home Assistant.
